variationPenalty.description: Suppress sharpening of smooth color variation.

directions.description: Clockwise image coordinates: 0° right, 90° down. Opposite rays are independent.

antiAlias.description: Conservative directional anti-alias refinement. Older files use the built-in defaults.

enabled.description: Stabilize green reconstruction where directional candidates disagree; disable for a comparison with the original decoder.

greenThreshold.description: Minimum horizontal/vertical green disagreement in normalized sensor units (0–1). Default: 12/255. Larger values preserve more of the original reconstruction.

chromaThreshold.description: Opposing red/blue tile transitions above this normalized magnitude protect real color boundaries. Default: 80/255.

directionFloor.description: Minimum neighborhood directional confidence required to change green. Default: 0.05.

directionSpan.description: Confidence interval over which the refinement fades from zero to full strength. Default: 0.25.

syntheticWeight.description: Relative contribution of reconstructed RGB-IR samples to neighborhood evidence. Original measured samples always have weight 1. Default: 0.25.

strength.description: Normalized gradient threshold; start at 0 and increase strictly.

uniform.description: Uniform-weight fraction: 1 = balanced, 0 = fully edge weighted.

edgePower.description: Larger values reject samples across color edges more strongly.

tangentBias.description: Preference for candidates along the edge tangent.
